0022600164.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-6) are still seeking their first win of 2026-27, sitting 15th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific, with a six-game losing streak and an 0-4 road record. The Dallas Mavericks (4-2) are 7th in the West, 2 games back in the Southwest, and riding a three-game winning streak. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while Zach LaVine is day-to-day with elbow soreness and is a game-time decision. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet this season, while the Kings won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 130-121 win in Dallas on February 26, 2026.
